people.imagined: Dusk at the first landing. He has just brought the stamp down on a pass and is pausing, as he always does, to weigh the traveller; lamp on the table; a blank slip lying out for the next hand.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk in the gate-house of a river ferry guild, he holds a bronze stamp raised one inch above a blank slip of paper and looks over it at the viewer, deciding, as he always does, whether this traveller is who the pass will say. Face: a square, sun-browned, slightly heavy face; deep frown-lines between thick level black brows; small dark eyes that take a long time to settle on you; a short flat nose with a pale line across its bridge where spectacles never sat but a hat-brim did; the mouth pressed into a straight line, the lower lip pushed a little forward; skin weathered and pitted at the cheeks, with a pale band across the forehead where a straw hat usually sits. Hair: black with grey at both temples, combed flat and tied in a short topknot with a strip of green cloth. Body: broad-shouldered and thickset, sitting very upright on a low stool at a low plank table, elbows in. Clothing: an inner shirt of undyed linen with a rolled collar; over it a river-green oiled coat, glossy, clean and fitted, fastened with five bronze toggles to the throat; sleeves rolled once to show thick wrists; a plain brown cord belt; no hat, which hangs on a peg behind him. Hands and objects: both thick hands hold a palm-sized bronze stamp with a short wooden handle; before him a squat clay ink pot with a thumb-smudge on its rim, one blank slip lying out, and a small stack of more blank slips (no marks, no writing anywhere). Background: a dark plank wall, one hanging oil lamp on a rope-hook, a bundle of tied passes on a nail, and a small window showing a dim brown river at dusk. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left on his face and the bronze, a cool blue dusk behind. Expression: patient, unhurried suspicion; the slightly lowered chin of a man who fines his own cousins and enjoys being right.

people.imagined: Midday on the awning boat's stern, tiller under her arm. A stranger has asked about the boat's name and she is deciding whether to answer. The headcloth is the thing she will not wash.
people.subject: The moment: midday on the stern of a river boat with a curved reed awning, tiller clamped under her right arm; a stranger has just asked about the boat's name and she is deciding whether to answer. She looks down her nose at the viewer, chin lifted. Face: a broad, strong face with high flat cheekbones and deep-tanned skin; a wide mouth with a full lower lip set stubbornly; heavy straight black brows; river-brown eyes with deep crow's feet; a small old nick in the left ear lobe where an earring was pulled out; a faint sun-peel on the nose. Hair: thick black hair coiled low at the nape and almost covered by a faded green headcloth, stiff and soft at once, gone grey-green at the folds, knotted above the forehead; it has not been washed since her mother wore it, and it is the most noticeable thing in the picture. Body: tall and broad-shouldered, planted with her feet apart as on a rocking deck, hip leaning on the tiller. Clothing: a plain linen shirt with a rolled neck; over it a dark river-green oilcloth coat, clean and well cut, buttoned only at the waist, sleeves pushed to the elbow; a wide brown sash knotted at the left hip; bare feet on the planks. Hands and objects: her right forearm clamps a long, worn wooden tiller polished dark by hands; her left hand holds a tied coil of hemp rope with one finger hooked through it. Background: the curved reed awning, bright river water throwing small reflections, a thin line of pine bank, a rope-wrapped bollard. Light: hard noon sun from the upper left, glitter off the water on her chin and neck. Expression: proud and defiant, generous at the eyes, stubborn at the mouth, ready to refuse.

people.imagined: Early afternoon, asleep on the deck against a coil of hemp rope until a shadow falls on him; he is just waking.
people.subject: The moment: early afternoon on the deck of the awning boat; he has fallen asleep sitting against a coil of hemp rope with a half-made splice in his hands, and a shadow has just fallen on him; he is half awake, eyes slits, to see the viewer. Face: a round boyish face of seventeen with the braided pattern of the rope pressed in red lines across his left cheek, big and plain; a snub nose; sleepy heavy-lidded brown eyes; a small crooked grin starting; scattered freckles; a smear of black tar on the chin; a trace of dribble at one corner of the mouth. Hair: a messy tangle of black hair sticking up on one side where he lay on it, a wisp of straw caught in it. Body: slim and slumped, long-legged, one knee drawn up, shoulders sagging against the coil. Clothing: a brown oiled coat a size too big for him, sleeves rolled three times, hanging open over a grey cotton shirt with one button missing; a plain brown headcloth tied loosely round his neck instead of on his head; rolled canvas trousers; bare dirty feet. Hands and objects: one hand holds a half-finished rope splice, an unravelled end with an iron marlin spike stuck through the strands; the other hand droops open in his lap, palm up, calloused at the base of each finger. Background: great pale coils of hemp, a plank deck with dark damp stains, the edge of a pale reed awning, a rope end trailing over the side. Light: warm lazy afternoon sun from the upper left, dust motes, a stripe of shade across his legs. Expression: drowsy, easy, forgiving; a half-smile before he is fully awake, no worry in him at all.

people.imagined: Morning on the first landing. She is checking a line of passengers; she has stopped one and is reading his face as if it were his pass.
people.subject: The moment: morning on the first landing of the ferry guild; she has just stopped a passenger in the queue, and tilting her head she reads his face as if it were his pass. She studies the viewer closely. Face: a sharp, narrow face of twenty with a firm small chin; straight thin black brows set a little low; clear, steady dark eyes that do not blink often; a small straight nose; lips pressed thin, the corners dimpling in secret enjoyment; pale-brown skin scrubbed clean, a faint pink on the cheekbones from the morning cold. Hair: black, in two tight braids pinned up flat on the crown, a green headcloth knotted over them at the back with the tails hanging. Body: small, spare and straight-backed, standing square, shoulders back as a clerk's daughter taught to stand. Clothing: a clean river-green oiled coat with a straight stand collar and two rows of bronze toggles, cuffs turned back neatly twice to show white linen; a brown sash tied in a flat knot at the front; coarse trousers and bare feet on the planking. Hands and objects: an iron stamp the size of a plum swings on a cord round her neck and lies on her chest, large and plainly visible; her right hand holds the cord up between two fingers as she looks, while the left holds a clipboard-like flat board with several blank slips clipped on (no writing). Background: a wooden landing with mooring posts, a blurred queue of travellers with bundles and a goat, thin river mist, a ferry hull. Light: cool morning light from the upper left, a bright rim on her braids. Expression: severe, alert and unimpressed, with the corner of the mouth enjoying itself.

people.imagined: Night on the Đào Sa landing. He drills with a pole every night. Planks seem to groan near him. He has just stopped, breathing hard, and looks toward the river.
people.subject: The moment: night on the Đào Sa landing, where his parents burned. He has just finished his nightly pole drill, breathing hard, and he glares at the viewer. Face: a lean, hard young face of twenty-nine, jaw clenched, brows slanting sharply down in the middle; dark red-rimmed eyes that have not slept enough; a thin nose with flared nostrils; sweat running down the forehead and temple; a faint white scar through the upper lip; skin deeply sunburnt and peeling at the nose. Hair: short black hair cropped rough with a knife, a brown headcloth knotted at the back of the neck, damp with sweat. Body: wiry and hard, tight at the shoulders, forward-leaning and still braced for the next stroke. Clothing: a brown oiled coat hanging open at the collar, the sleeves cut short at the elbow and neatly hemmed afterwards with coarse black thread; underneath, grey cotton cloth wrapped tight across the chest; rolled canvas trousers black with river water. Hands and objects: his left hand grips a long boat-pole near the top; his right hand is held up, showing the first two fingers crushed flat and shortened at the second joint by a winch long ago, big and obvious in the foreground; a length of rope with a chafed end hangs from the pole and a wet nail is stuck in the planks at his feet. Background: a dark landing of black planks, charred stumps of old posts at one side, still black water with a thin reflection of one lantern. Light: a single lantern set low on the upper left throws a hard orange light on his face and a long shadow across the planks. Expression: wrathful, loyal, fixed on something across the water.

people.imagined: Night on the river, a boat with a small tin lamp. She has just been called a liar and lifts her eyes to look at the viewer evenly.
people.subject: The moment: night on the river; she sits in a small rowing boat with a tin lamp at her belt, and has just been called a liar by the pilgrims at the landing. She lifts her eyes and looks steadily at the viewer, as one who has told the truth and will not argue. Face: a calm oval face of twenty-two with a high forehead; level dark eyes, wide-set and unhurried; a small firm mouth; plain skin with a light freckling across the nose; straight dark brows; a small healing scrape on the chin from the oar handle. Hair: one long black braid brought forward over her left shoulder and tied with green thread, a green headcloth over the crown, a few damp strands on her temples. Body: slim and steady, sitting very still with her back straight on the thwart. Clothing: a river-green oiled coat buttoned to the chest with bronze toggles, sleeves rolled to the elbow, over a grey shirt; a brown sash round the waist; wet canvas trousers; bare feet braced against a rib of the boat. Hands and objects: a small round tin lamp with a pierced lid hangs from her belt and sits at chest height in the frame, a pinpoint flame showing through the holes; her left hand holds one oar loosely, the other resting on her knee. Background: dark water with a trail of ripples, the faint grey shape of a cliff, low mist, a single far shore light. Light: the tin lamp's warm point on her chest, chin and cheek; dim blue night everywhere else. Expression: calm, brave, unbothered; a person who knows what she saw.

people.imagined: Dockside, a rope-maker's boy telling a smooth lie, grinning. Nobody has ever noticed the grin.
people.subject: The moment: on the dock by the rope-walk he tells a smooth lie to a buyer; his grin is wide and easy while his eyes stay flat. Nobody has ever noticed. He looks at the viewer with that grin. Face: a thin, lively face of eighteen; a wide grin showing a chipped front tooth; narrow bright eyes that do not smile with the mouth; eyebrows raised high and arched; ears that stick out; sunburnt cheeks with a few spots; a thin line of tar under one nostril. Hair: brown, cropped short and standing in spikes, a brown headcloth tied round the forehead and pushed back. Body: wiry and restless, weight on the balls of his feet, leaning toward the viewer. Clothing: a brown oiled coat in far better condition than a deck boy's, clean toggles, sleeves rolled; a clean grey shirt; a new, bright blue cotton scarf of fine weave knotted at his neck, plainly new and out of place; canvas trousers; sandals tied with new cord. Hands and objects: one hand tosses a short twist of tarred rope up and catches it; the other rests on his hip with the thumb in the belt. Background: tall rope-walk poles with pale hanks of hemp hanging between them, a dock of grey planks, a brown river with a boat, a rope-maker's cart. Light: bright midday sun from the upper left, hard shadow under his chin. Expression: cheerful and warm on the surface, false underneath; a salesman's delight in himself.

people.imagined: The spring flood, the ferry master on the quay shouting to a boat three bends away. The toll seal at his wrist swings as he cups a hand to his mouth.
people.subject: The moment: the spring flood, on the quay; the ferry master has just shouted to a boat three bends away with his right hand cupped at his mouth and lowers it, turning to the viewer with a hearty grin. Face: a big, square, river-tanned face with a heavy jaw; a thick black moustache streaked grey and wet with spray; deep laugh-lines and squint-lines; large bright brown eyes; a broad nose with a red tinge of old drinking; a wide mouth with a full lower lip; a forehead furrowed by a lifetime of squinting at water. Hair: black shot with grey, in a thick topknot held with a bronze pin, a few loose locks stuck to his temples. Body: a barrel of a man, huge chest and arms, thick neck, standing with feet wide. Clothing: a heavy oiled sharkskin coat over river-reed scales, dark green-black, glossy, spotless and well fitted, collar turned up; a grey wool shirt beneath; a wide leather belt with a big bronze buckle; canvas trousers; no hat. Hands and objects: a round bronze seal as big as a hen's egg hangs on a cord at his right wrist and swings, clearly visible against the dark sleeve; the hand is still raised. Background: a flood-brown river, a row of ferries tied at a landing, tall nine-fold bends of bank, a grey spring sky. Light: bright spring light from the upper left, bronze glints from the seal. Expression: hearty, bold, and a little greedy-warm, a man who loves his river and its tolls.

people.imagined: A shipyard at the fleet's rebuilding; she holds out her two burned palms to take a plank, then looks up.
people.subject: The moment: in the boatyard at the fleet's rebuilding she turns from a half-built hull, holds up both hands, palms toward the viewer, as if checking them, and looks over them. Face: a long, weathered face of forty-six with high cheekbones; a strong straight nose; calm grey-brown eyes with fine lines at the corners; thin lips shut; no powder; a faint scar through the left eyebrow. Hair: white, cropped short like a deckhand's, blunt over the ears, no headcloth, a little sawdust in it. Body: tall, rangy and straight-backed, standing easy. Clothing: a dark green oiled coat of fine cloth, buttoned, sleeves rolled to the elbow; an undyed linen scarf round her neck; a belt of braided cord; a grey shirt; canvas trousers dusted with sawdust. Hands and objects: both palms, held up and open, show shiny, pink, puckered burn scars across the whole of each, large and plain; over one shoulder a pale folded square of sail cloth. Background: the pale ribs of an unfinished boat, stacks of planks, adzes on a bench, a river beyond. Light: soft bright morning light from the upper left, warm on the pale wood of the hull and catching the sawdust in her white hair. Expression: calm, brave and quietly just, a woman who has nothing more to prove.

people.imagined: At the Đào Sa landing he turns, hearing the River Hall's talk; the half-healed scar on his cheek pulls when he scowls.
people.subject: The moment: at the Đào Sa landing at red evening he has just heard the River Hall's talk about letters and turns his head sharply with a scowl, the new scar pulling, to fix the viewer. Face: a heavy, square face like his father's, but hard and unsmiling; a half-healed, raised pink scar slanting across his right cheek from ear to mouth, big and obvious; thick brows drawn down; dark cold eyes; a clenched jaw with black stubble; the upper lip lifted on one side by the scar. Hair: black, tied tight in a topknot with a tarred cord, no strands loose. Body: thick-chested, squared shoulders, a boxer's neck. Clothing: a tar-black oiled coat with a high collar, fitted and clean; sleeves rolled to show forearms scarred pink with burns; a grey shirt; a belt with a heavy bronze buckle; black boots. Hands and objects: his fist grips the shaft of a boat-pole planted beside him; the knuckles are burn-scarred and shiny. Background: charred posts on the landing, a few new planks beside old black ones, a red-grey evening river. Light: hard light from the upper left on the scar, red dusk behind him. Expression: wrathful, with a cruel set to the mouth; a man who wants a war back.

people.imagined: Dawn at the eighth bend. He rows a boat and will not look at the water, only at the far bank.
people.subject: The moment: dawn at the eighth bend; he rows a small boat, and will not look at the water, only at the far bank; he looks at the viewer sideways only. Face: a narrow, closed face, grey-pale from avoiding glare; a long upper lip; thin mouth; small cautious eyes with the whites showing at the sides; a thin nose; deep lines at the corners of the eyes; thin grey stubble; a small old cut across one eyebrow. Hair: thin black hair streaked grey and pulled back under a wide-brimmed straw hat tied with a cord. Body: lean and a little hunched, narrow shoulders, sitting rigid on the thwart. Clothing: a drab green-grey oiled coat, buttoned tight to the throat, spotless, an undyed linen scarf; grey trousers; oiled river boots; no ornament. Hands and objects: both hands rest on two long oars; at his feet a fat live pink pig tied by the legs in a rope net, clearly visible and squealing. Background: a deep dark river bend, low mist rising, steep wooded banks, a faint ripple far out. Light: pale grey dawn from the upper left. Expression: wary, withdrawn and cold; a pilot who has been taking boats past something for years.

people.imagined: In the rope-walk, he lifts a coil of hemp to his nose and sniffs it, then looks up; bits of fibre cling in his eyebrows.
people.subject: The moment: in the rope store he lifts a coil of hemp to his nose and sniffs it, then looks up over it at the viewer, mid-sniff; fibres cling in his eyebrows. Face: a pinched, shrewd face of forty-four with a long nose; fibres of pale hemp caught in thick bushy black eyebrows, big and clear; small close-set brown eyes narrowed; thin lips in a polite smile; a pointed chin; fine dry skin. Hair: oiled black hair parted on the left and combed smooth, a few grey strands. Body: slight, stooped a little, neat in every line. Clothing: a dark green oiled coat with a rolled collar, perfectly clean and tailored; a fine grey linen shirt; a brown vest; narrow trousers; a small brass tally-bead cord wound twice at the right wrist. Hands and objects: both hands hold a pale coil of hemp rope at the nose; at his belt hangs a small hooked knife. Background: rows of hanging rope hanks in different thicknesses, ropes on pegs, a brown plank wall, a ledger-free shelf of tarry jars. Light: warm dusty light from the upper left, motes of hemp dust drifting. Expression: pleasant, patient and calculating; a smile that has already priced you.

people.imagined: Grey morning at the gold-washers' bank. She shakes the jar of rusted nails at her belt, deciding, then looks up.
people.subject: The moment: a grey morning at the gold-washers' bank; she rattles the jar of rusted nails by her ear, deciding, and looks up at the viewer. Face: a sharp-boned weathered face of forty; heavy dark arched brows, one set higher than the other; hard dark eyes; a thin tight mouth; a nose broken slightly at the bridge; a fine scar over the right brow; deep-tan skin with a fine web of lines. Hair: black with one broad grey streak, in a thick plait over the right shoulder tied with tarred cord, a green headcloth. Body: wiry and upright, tense as a drawn rope. Clothing: a tar-black oiled coat, clean and well fitted, over a grey shirt; a wide leather belt; sleeves rolled; wet canvas trousers; shin-high mud boots. Hands and objects: in the right hand a small clay jar, lid off, full of rust-red bent nails, held up near the ear; the left hand holds one nail between thumb and forefinger, turning it; a gold-washer's shallow wooden pan leans at her feet. Background: river shallows with wooden wash-pans, a line of washers stooped far off, grey mist. Light: flat grey light from the upper left, no shadow. Expression: arbitrary, stern, ready to be wrathful on a whim.

people.imagined: Bouncing on her toes at the crossing, waiting for the boat, eating half a flatbread.
people.subject: The moment: on a crossing landing she rises on her toes, waiting for the boat, a half-eaten flatbread in her hand; she has never finished a meal sitting down. She grins at the viewer, eager. Face: a bright round face of eighteen; wide-open dark eyes; a gap between her front teeth; rosy tan cheeks; short straight brows raised; a crumb at the corner of her mouth; freckles; her coat's left cuff is turned back where the wind at the river mouth tugs at it. Hair: two short black pigtails sticking out sideways, a green headcloth tied crooked. Body: small and springy, caught mid-bounce. Clothing: a green oiled coat with rolled sleeves and the bottom toggle missing; a clean white shirt; a brown belt; canvas trousers rolled to the knee; bare feet on grey planking. Hands and objects: a half-eaten round flatbread in her right hand with a bite out of it; the other hand points to the river mouth; her knees are scabbed from climbing mooring posts, and her bare toes grip the planks like fingers. Background: a river mouth glittering far off, a wooden landing with a coil of rope, a small ferry arriving; a green bead on a string at her wrist, a gift from the crossing-keepers' village; the bread is warm and a thread of steam still rises from the broken edge. Light: bright light from the upper left. Expression: impatient, gregarious and full of hope.

people.imagined: At the landing he is telling pilgrims about the serpent's eye, hands wide; a tuft of hair stands up.
people.subject: The moment: at the landing he is telling pilgrims about the serpent's eye; he spreads one arm wide to show its size and grins at the viewer mid-story, a tuft of hair standing up. Face: a long, friendly face of twenty-two; a tuft of hair standing straight up at the crown, big and obvious; wide-set dark eyes, very open and bright; a broad smile with one dimple; a thin fuzz of moustache. Hair: black, with a stubborn cowlick; no headcloth. Body: long-limbed and lanky, leaning forward, one arm swept out; a small tin charm of a serpent hangs on a thong round his neck, bought from a pedlar. Clothing: a green oiled coat, clean, with sleeves rolled, over a light shirt; a brown sash; canvas trousers; bare feet; his sleeves are rolled unevenly, the left higher than the right; his big bare feet are muddy to the ankle and one toe is bandaged with a strip of green cloth. Hands and objects: the raised hand holds up a single copper coin between two fingers; the other arm is spread wide as if holding an enormous eye; two pilgrims' hands holding out coppers appear blurred at the frame's edge. Background: blurred pilgrims with bundles, a river bend with mist, a tin lamp hung on a post. Light: warm afternoon sun from the upper left. Expression: calm and easy with a storyteller's glint, loyal under it.

people.imagined: Evening in his lean-to. He counts coppers from a peg-hole with a bent thumb, and looks up suspicious of whoever is at the door.
people.subject: The moment: evening in his lean-to; he counts coppers from a peg-hole with a bent thumb and looks up, suspicious of whoever is at the door, covering the coins with one hand. Face: a thin, narrow face of thirty-two with sunken cheeks; deep-set darting eyes with dark rings; a long hooked nose; a thin tight mouth; stubble; a vertical worry line between the brows. Hair: thin dark hair tied in a knot, a brown headcloth. Body: small, thin and bent over the table; his shoulders are drawn up toward his ears as though he expects a blow. Clothing: a brown oiled coat, clean but dull, sleeves rolled, with a leather apron over for rope-work; a grey shirt; a cord belt with a hooked knife; a grey patch of old oilcloth is stitched over one elbow. Hands and objects: his left thumb is bent and crooked and rests on a stack of copper coins pulled from a wooden peg-hole; a small iron rope fitting lies in front of him with a file; the peg-hole hoard is a plank drilled with thirty small holes, each holding a plug of coppers, three plugs drawn out and scattered; his bent thumb is ridged with a hard yellow callus. Background: a plank wall with a row of peg-holes, small rope fittings hanging from nails, a bundle of tarred string; the candle has burned low and drips onto a dented tin saucer. Light: a single candle low from the upper left, orange. Expression: greedy, paranoid, watchful.

people.imagined: At the Ngư Ca landing, with a folded paper in her hands, she smiles with the early-white forelock in the wind.
people.subject: The moment: at the Ngư Ca landing she has just taken a folded paper in answer and holds it to her chest, smiling openly at the viewer. Face: a soft round open face of sixteen; large trusting brown eyes; a warm smile; round tanned cheeks with a small dimple; a ferry rope slaps against a post behind her and a gull stands on a mooring post, watching. Hair: black, in a long braid over one shoulder, with a single lock at the front already white, early like her grandmother's, striking against the black; a green headcloth; on her wrist a thin green ribbon is tied, her grandmother's gift; her braid is tied off with a bit of blue thread. Body: slight, young, standing very straight with elbows tucked. Clothing: a clean green oiled coat of good cloth with bronze toggles, a plain brown sash, sleeves to the wrist; a white shirt collar; trousers with rolled hems; sandals. Hands and objects: a small square of folded paper held in both hands at her chest (no writing visible); a wicker satchel at her hip; the paper has a faint ink stain at one corner but nothing readable. Background: a river landing with a ferry and boatmen, soft bright river, reeds; her toes are wet from stepping off the boat and leave small prints on the dry plank. Light: gentle morning light from the upper left. Expression: trusting, generous and glad.

people.imagined: Spring landing: he touches the oilcloth-wrapped splinter at his chest before speaking.
people.subject: The moment: at the spring landing he lays two fingers on a small oilcloth bundle at his chest, about to speak, and looks straight at the viewer. Face: a serious, long face of twenty-four with a stubborn square jaw; dark steady eyes under heavy brows; a faint line either side of the mouth; clean-shaven; pale brown skin; a small scar at the chin. Hair: black, tied tight in a low knot at the nape, no headcloth. Body: tall, angular and rigid, standing as if at a ceremony. Clothing: a dark green oiled coat, tidy, buttoned, over a plain linen shirt; a plain linen scarf; dark trousers; boots with mended soles; the oilcloth bundle is tied with a double knot of waxed thread and has a thumbnail-shaped dent where he has pressed it for years; his boots are damp at the toes from the landing; a green headcloth is folded at his belt, untied, as if he refuses to wear it before the old gate's name is spoken. Hands and objects: a small oblong bundle of yellow oilcloth the length of a finger hangs on a cord at his breast, under his two fingers (a splinter of old wood inside, unseen). Background: a dim river-hall with brown planks and a lantern; a blurred row of boat-families standing; behind him a few older boatmen look away, arms folded. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: stubborn, solemn and resolved.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at the moment he lashed the surviving boats together across the river in 790 and would not untie them.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened: the founder stands on a lashed boat in 790 with a hemp rope in both hands, looking steadily at the viewer, refusing to untie it. Face: a broad patient face of fifty with deep kind lines; heavy brows; calm wide-set eyes; a wide mouth with a faint smile; a short grey beard; skin ruddy and creased; the lashed boats behind him show twenty hulls roped bow to stern with a hundred knots; a faded brown cord hangs from his neck with a small bronze toll disc (no text). Hair: grey-streaked black in a topknot bound with rope-cord; the painting's silk shows horizontal creases where it was once folded, and a hairline crack through the left cheek, but the eyes remain clear and warm. Body: stocky, strong and broad-shouldered, feet apart on the deck; a grey cat sits on the nearest gunwale. Clothing: a plain river-green oiled coat with a rope belt, sleeves rolled to the elbow; a straw hat hung at the back of his neck; bare feet. Hands and objects: both hands grip a thick hemp rope pulled tight round a bollard; the rope is wet and heavy; one hull carries a lamp, another a child asleep in a basket. Background: a river crowded with boats lashed side by side across the water, smoke far off. Light: soft muted faded light from the upper left. Expression: patient, just and immovable.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the ferryman who would not leave his boat when the landing burned in 1173.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened: the ferryman at the helm of his ferry with both hands on the sweep as fire-glow shows behind him; he would not leave his boat. Face: a rounded, weathered face of forty-five with a gentle contented half-smile; calm brown eyes; a thick black moustache; strong brows; creased skin; his moustache is lightly dusted with ash blown from the burning landing; a brown dog sits beside him on the deck refusing to jump ship. Hair: black, tied up with a green cloth. Body: broad, steady and planted. Clothing: a river-green oiled coat, sleeves rolled, a rope belt, no hat; a plain shirt. Hands and objects: both hands rest on the long wooden sweep of the ferry; a lantern hangs from a hook; the sweep's handle is polished pale where his palms wore it, a worn groove in the wood. Background: a faint warm red-orange glow beyond the boat, smoke, the river; the memorial silk is yellowed to honey, its edges blackened as by smoke, a small mend visible at the lower left. Light: faded warm light from the upper left, an orange tint at the back; the red glow throws his shadow long across the planks. Expression: loyal, content and unafraid.
